title: extract_header_value in lifecycle.rs does not unfold RFC 5322 folded headers
description: lifecycle.rs extract_header_value() (line 1282) splits on lines() and matches prefix but does NOT unfold continuation lines (RFC 5322 §2.2.3). overview.rs extract_overview() correctly handles folded headers via a manual unfolding loop. A Message-ID header that is folded (standards-legal) would not be extracted, leaving message_id empty in lookup_article_content_by_number and lookup_article_by_cid, causing the X-Stoa-DID-Verified header lookup to query by empty string and silently fail. The two implementations diverge on this point and the inconsistency is a maintenance trap.
